rationale: Builds on the best reverse-tail recurrent family with a compact structural edit instead of another scalar sweep. I added trainable tail_anchor_gates that refresh the reverse-traversal anchor after each recurrent tail block, so the carry path can interpolate between the original decoder-output anchor and progressively improved tail states. This targets the local signal that anchor-refresh variants were close while keeping shapes, wallclock behavior, quant-aware export, and artifact size essentially unchanged.
title: Learned Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh
